exhaustive_enums.name: GatewaydError
exhaustive_enums.reason: This enum was already exhaustive in the public API. Keeping it exhaustive preserves downstream matches; future operations that need extensible errors should introduce a new opaque or non-exhaustive error type without changing this contract.

exhaustive_enums.name: RuntimeReadiness
exhaustive_enums.reason: This enum was already exhaustive in the public API. Keeping it exhaustive preserves downstream readiness matches; an extensible successor must be introduced additively.

exhaustive_enums.name: Operation
exhaustive_enums.reason: Every operation that changes the data plane must reach the audit trail; a new operation must fail to compile in each operation log until the log records it.

exhaustive_enums.name: DomainError
exhaustive_enums.reason: This enum was already exhaustive in the public API. Keeping it exhaustive preserves downstream matches; new extensible domain operations should expose a new opaque or non-exhaustive error type.

exhaustive_enums.name: Body
exhaustive_enums.reason: A directive ends with ';', a block, or neither when it is malformed; the syntax has no other form, and the formatter and the language must handle each one.

exhaustive_enums.name: Trivia
exhaustive_enums.reason: Between directives the syntax has only comments and blank lines; the formatter must place every kind, so a new kind is a deliberate breaking change.

exhaustive_enums.name: DiagnosticSeverity
exhaustive_enums.reason: panel-contracts maps every severity onto the protobuf enum. A new severity must fail to compile there rather than be silently reported as an existing one.

exhaustive_enums.name: RouteMatcher
exhaustive_enums.reason: gateway-grpc encodes every matcher onto the wire. A new matcher must fail to compile there rather than make a route silently unserialisable.

exhaustive_enums.name: RouteAction
exhaustive_enums.reason: gateway-grpc encodes every action onto the wire. A new action must fail to compile there rather than make a route silently unserialisable.

exhaustive_enums.name: LoadBalancingPolicy
exhaustive_enums.reason: gateway-grpc encodes every policy onto the wire, and gateway-pingora maps it onto a Pingora selector. A new policy must fail to compile in both rather than fall back to an unintended one.

exhaustive_enums.name: AccessLogFormat
exhaustive_enums.reason: gateway-proto-codec maps every access log format onto the protobuf enum. A new format must fail to compile there rather than be sent as the enclosing scope's format.

exhaustive_enums.name: WwwRedirect
exhaustive_enums.reason: gateway-proto-codec maps every redirect mode onto the protobuf enum. A new mode must fail to compile there rather than be sent as no redirect.

exhaustive_enums.name: HealthCheckProtocol
exhaustive_enums.reason: gateway-proto-codec encodes every probe protocol onto the wire, and gateway-pingora builds a probe for each. A new protocol must fail to compile in both rather than probe the wrong way.

exhaustive_enums.name: AlertChannelKind
exhaustive_enums.reason: A channel's kind decides where notifications go; a new kind must fail to compile until every adapter sends it, rather than being sent as a webhook.

exhaustive_enums.name: AlertComparison
exhaustive_enums.reason: A rule's comparison decides when it fires; an adapter must never map an unknown comparison to another one, so a new comparison must fail to compile until every adapter handles it.

exhaustive_enums.name: AlertMeasure
exhaustive_enums.reason: Each measure is a fixed query in observability-service and a field of the alerts contract; a new measure must fail to compile in every adapter until it maps the measure, rather than reading as another one.

exhaustive_enums.name: AlertSeverity
exhaustive_enums.reason: Severity travels to receivers as a notification label; a new severity must fail to compile until every adapter carries it, rather than reaching receivers as another severity.

exhaustive_enums.name: AgentCapability
exhaustive_enums.reason: The console offers a host action only for a capability the agent reports; a new capability must fail to compile in every adapter until it is mapped, rather than being shown as another one.

exhaustive_enums.name: CapabilityState
exhaustive_enums.reason: A capability's state decides whether its actions are offered; a new state must fail to compile until every adapter maps it, rather than reading as available.

exhaustive_enums.name: DirectoryKind
exhaustive_enums.reason: Each kind is a directory the agent's configuration names; a new kind must fail to compile until every adapter labels it, rather than being reported as another directory.

exhaustive_enums.name: UnitAction
exhaustive_enums.reason: Each action is a job systemd runs on the gateway's unit and an audit event of its own; a new action must fail to compile in every adapter until it maps it, rather than running another job.
